## Design

### 2026-10-11 – What worked

**5h**

What worked
The design is settled: ESP32-C3, SSD1351 OLED, battery with a USB-C charger, and a website that sends images and syncs time. The web page was redesigned to look more professional.

What didn't work, or isn't proven

The LED matrix version didn't give you results you liked, so we dropped it.
I haven't tested any code on real hardware. It hasn't been compiled or run, so small fixes may be needed.
The screen-dimming command may not work on some library versions.
It doesn't work on iPhone, because Web Bluetooth needs Chrome on Android or desktop.
The website must be hosted on HTTPS.
The clock resets if the battery dies, so you'd need to sync time again.
Next step: build the prototype and report any errors. today, I have only made the photo and emoji sharing website.
